nodes.name: Atum → Shu/Tefnut → Geb/Nut → Osiris & Isis → Horus
nodes.notes: Egyptian royal king lists trace historical pharaohs directly from the Ennead and Horus through the Shemsu-Hor ('Followers of Horus'). Osiris placed in a chest/ark on the Nile was later compared by syncretists to Noah.

nodes.name: Thoth (Djehuty / Hermes) & King Saurid (Surid)
nodes.role: Egyptian Scribe of the Gods / Antediluvian Pyramid Builder
nodes.notes: Greco-Egyptian, Hermetic, Coptic, and Arabic histories explicitly identify Biblical Enoch (Idris) with Egyptian Thoth / Hermes Trismegistus and the antediluvian Egyptian King Saurid (Surid), who foresaw the Flood and built the Pyramids to preserve astronomy and sacred wisdom!

nodes.name: Menes / Narmer (1st Dynasty) & Baysar (Misrayim)
nodes.notes: Historical unifier of Egypt. Medieval Coptic/Arabic chronicles (al-Maqrizi) trace post-Flood Egyptian kings from Ham -> Baysar -> Misrayim (Mizraim), while Book of Jasher 14 recounts Rikayon establishing the royal title 'Pharaoh'!

nodes.name: Imhotep (Vizier of Djoser / 7-Year Famine)
nodes.era: Old Kingdom (3rd Dynasty) / Ptolemaic Famine Stela
nodes.notes: Master architect of the Step Pyramid and high priest of Heliopolis (On). The Sehel Island Famine Stela credits Imhotep with ending a 7-year Nile famine—frequently compared in cross-cultural lore with Joseph (Zaphenath-Paneah), who wed the daughter of the Priest of On!

nodes.name: Osarseph (Manetho) / Musaeus (Artapanus) / Bithiah & Adoniah
nodes.notes: Manetho preserves an Egyptian tradition of a Heliopolitan priest named Osarseph who took the name Moses; Artapanus calls Moses 'Musaeus' (teacher of Orpheus) and Egyptian 'Hermes', leading an expedition into Cush/Ethiopia — strikingly echoing Book of Jasher 72-76 where Moses rules Cush with Queen Adoniah!

nodes.name: Protogonos → Misor & Sydyk → Taaut (Thoth) & Chna (Canaan)
sources: Philo of Byblos / Sanchuniathon (via Eusebius Praep. Ev. I.10)
nodes.notes: Explicitly names Misor (direct cognate of Biblical Mizraim!) as brother of Sydyk (Righteousness, cf. Melchizedek) and father of Taaut (Egyptian Thoth, inventor of writing), alongside Chna (Canaan).

nodes.name: Apsu & Tiamat → Anu → Enki (Ea) → Marduk
nodes.notes: Enki (Ea) and Nintu shape the first humans (Lullu) from clay mixed with divine blood, paralleling Genesis's creation of Adam from dust.

nodes.name: Alulim of Eridu → Antediluvian Kings (1-6)
nodes.notes: 8 kings in the Sumerian King List (10 in Berossus: Aloros -> Alaparos -> Amelon -> Ammenon -> Megalaros -> Daonos), reigning vast lifespans before the Flood — paralleling Genesis 5's 10 patriarchs.

nodes.name: En-men-dur-ana (Enmeduranki, 7th King of Sippar)
nodes.role: 7th King / Initiated into Heavenly Secrets by Shamash
nodes.notes: 7th antediluvian king, ruler of Sippar (city of sun god Shamash), admitted to heaven to learn celestial tablets and divination — widely recognized parallel to Enoch (7th patriarch, 365 solar years).

nodes.name: Ubara-Tutu → Ziusudra / Utnapishtim / Atrahasis
nodes.notes: King/sage of Shuruppak warned by Enki/Ea; builds a vessel preserving family and animals, sends out dove/swallow/raven, lands on Mt. Nimush.

nodes.name: Meskiaggasher → Enmerkar → Lugalbanda → Gilgamesh
nodes.notes: Gilgamesh journeys to Flood survivor Utnapishtim. Uruk is explicitly named 'Erech' in Gen 10:10 — and remarkably, 'Gilgamesh' is ALSO named as one of the Giants in the Dead Sea Scrolls Book of Giants (4Q530)!

nodes.name: Sargon of Akkad → Enheduanna & Naram-Sin
nodes.notes: Founder of Akkad (Biblical 'Accad' in Gen 10:10). Note also the striking 'basket in the river sealed with bitumen' motif in Sargon's Birth Legend paralleling Moses in Exodus 2!

nodes.name: Gayomart (Keyumars) → Mashya & Mashyana
nodes.notes: Created by Ahura Mazda. From Gayomart's seed grew a rhubarb plant splitting into Mashya & Mashyana, bearing 7 twin pairs populating the 7 climes of the world.

nodes.name: Siamak → Hushang → Tahmuras → Vivanghant
nodes.role: Father of Yima / Exact Proto-Indo-Iranian Bridge
nodes.notes: EXACT linguistic & genealogical cognate of Vedic Vivasvan (Surya)! One of the strongest academically verified prehistoric ancestral bridges between Iran and India.

nodes.name: Yima Khshaeta (Jamshid)
nodes.role: Golden Age King & Vara Ark Builder
nodes.notes: Son of Vivanghant — exact Proto-Indo-Iranian cognate of Vedic Yama. Warned by Ahura Mazda of a world-destroying winter/meltwater cataclysm, builds the subterranean Vara preserving pairs of humans, animals, and seeds.

nodes.name: Fereydun (Thraetaona)
nodes.role: Divider of the World Among Three Sons
nodes.notes: Divides the earth into three realms among his sons Salm (West), Tur (Turan/Steppe), and Iraj (Iran) — striking tripartite parallel to Noah.

nodes.name: Salm (West / Rum)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Fereydun; receives Anatolia and the West (Rum).

nodes.name: Tur (Turan / Central Asia)
nodes.notes: Second son of Fereydun; receives Turan (Central Asian steppes to China's borders).

nodes.name: Iraj (Iran → Manuchehr → Kayanians)
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Fereydun; receives Iran (Eranshahr), producing Manuchehr and the Kayanian dynasty (Kay Kavad, Kay Kavus, Siyavash, Kay Khosrow).

nodes.name: Medes (Mada) & Cyrus the Great (Achaemenids)
nodes.notes: Historical Medes directly match Biblical Madai (Gen 10:2); Cyrus ruled as King of Anshan in Elam (Gen 10:22).
